post.caption:
Wolves returned to Yellowstone in 1995. Elk stopped overgrazing riverbanks, willows and aspens recovered, beavers returned and built, banks stabilised, and the river began to meander differently. Scientists still debate how much was wolves versus drought and other factors, and the honest version is stronger than the viral one.
